injection:
Read this screenshot of an Eval Portal pass screen for the /injection review and extract three things.

1. Verdict: the large badge in the green header, PASS or NON-FAIL (a score such as "Score 5" may sit next to it). A FAIL result never gets a pass screen.
2. Review: the line under the verdict, like "/injection · <review name> · COMPLETE". It must say exactly /injection.
3. Verification code: find the label containing the words VERIFICATION CODE. It may start with a pen or lock icon and go on with text such as "· THE INJECTION FINGERPRINT, AS YOUR OUTLIER TASK SHOWS IT". The code is the large monospace text directly under that label. It can wrap onto two lines: join them with one space. Examples, written the way you should return them:
- 135948 chars - BEGI ... MMIT
- 245 chars - I ne ... says (the first and last 4 characters can include spaces)
- 153 criteria, weight 371 | Titles 10552 letters - TheA ... JG80 (rubric codes look like this)
Under the code are helper lines such as "First 4 characters: capital letter B, ..." and "Last 4 characters: ...". Use them to get each first and last character exactly right: upper or lower case, digit or letter (0/O, 1/l/I) and spaces.
Older passes instead show a code like EVP-ABCD-1234-WXYZ in a box at the top right of the green header; if so, copy that code.
Ignore the ATTEMPT ID, OUTLIER ID and REPORT SHA-256 lines: they are not the code.

Normalization rules for the code:
- Write the dash before the first characters (–, — or -) as a plain hyphen: -
- Write the ellipsis between the first and last characters (… or ...) as three dots: ...
- Put a single space on each side of that hyphen and those dots.
- Copy everything else exactly as shown.

Whenever a VERIFICATION CODE section is visible, return its code, even if a character is hard to read: settle it with the helper lines and mention any doubt in reason. Never leave the code empty just because you are unsure.

Respond ONLY with a JSON object:
{"verdict": "PASS" or "NON-FAIL" or "FAIL" or "NOT EVALUATED", "score": 1 or 0, "verification_code": "the verification code, normalized as described above, or empty string if not found", "reason": "brief explanation"}

Score is 1 only for a PASS or NON-FAIL pass screen for /injection. If the screenshot is not a pass screen for /injection, or has no VERIFICATION CODE section at all, set verification_code to empty string, verdict to NOT EVALUATED and score to 0, and say why in reason.
